hooks.command: sh -c 'd="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}"; case "$d" in /*) ;; *) d="$PWD/$d";; esac; while :; do if [ -e "$d/.claude/hooks/coyote-gate.sh" ] || [ -e "$d/.claude/settings.json" ] || [ -e "$d/.git" ]; then break; fi; p=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$p" = "$d" ] && break; d=$p; done; h="$d/.claude/hooks/coyote-gate.sh"; if [ -f "$h" ] && grep -qF "gate check --ide" "$h"; then sh "$h"; [ $? -eq 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2; fi; echo "coyote: no encuentro .claude/hooks/coyote-gate.sh o no es el hook de coyote; el gate bloquea por seguridad" >&2; exit 2'
